verification_note: City clerk official results for the November 8, 2011 runoff list Greg Stanton 94,765 and Wes Gullett 74,320 with 128 of 128 precincts counted. The August 30, 2011 first round had no majority winner (Stanton 53,553 of 141,300), so the runoff is decisive.

source_locator: Citywide Summary, MAYOR race, TOTAL VOTES CAST column
verification_note: City clerk official results for the August 25, 2015 mayor and council election list Greg Stanton 85,629 (65.31 percent), Anna Maria Brennan 38,118 and Matthew Jette 7,356 with 125 of 125 precincts counted. Stanton won a majority in the first round. The 2026 clerk candidate packet cites City Charter Chapter XII Section 16: if no candidate receives a majority of votes for an office, the top two advance to a runoff. A majority winner is therefore elected in the first round. This packet states the current rule; the same structure is visible in the 2011 and 2018 contests, which went to runoffs without a majority.

Gallego won a majority in the first round, so no runoff followed.
